data.name: The Bleakest Keep 2
data.detailed_description:
Join Edward and his ever reliable confidante, Juliet, and help save the land in the action-packed roguelike, The Bleakest Keep 2!

Return to The Bleakest Keep

Sometime after Edward defeated the dark wizard Cormac, Edward, and the sorceress Juliet, have started taking the next steps to rebuilding the kingdom. But evil rises once again and with the kingdom in peril once more, Edward and Juliet must save the kingdom from darkness.

Bigger and Bleaker

The Bleakest Keep 2 has new enemies and new weapons, and Edward has picked up some new skills of his own! Ever wanted to dropkick a vampire? You're in luck.

  • Slay zombies, vampires, and even more dark fantasy creatures!

  • Knock enemies off their feet and send them ragdolling with powerful attacks, punches and kicks and other disrespectful ways to take out creatures of the night.

  • New weapons and more weapons to carry! Try out shotguns, dual wield pistols, or throw frying pans!

  • Enchantments (and curses!) can be applied to weapons for even more weapon variety!

Upgrade Your Gear

Juliet returns with more upgrades to sell! Juliet is even more well-stocked than before, her upgrades are practically overflowing. The Bleakest Keep 2 has a larger and more dynamic shop than the original game!

And More!

The Bleakest Keep 2 expands on the first game for a more expansive and casual experience. How will Edward and Juliet save the day once more? Find out in The Bleakest Keep 2!

data.short_description: The kingdom has been taken over by darkness once again. Hack your way through the keep, blast away your foes, or dropkick a vampire in this action-packed, dark fantasy roguelike. Edward and Juliet return in The Bleakest Keep 2!

content_descriptors.notes: Violence. Blood and gore. Implied nudity. Sexual innuendo, implied sex, and revealing outfits. Tabaco and alcohol. Some swearing and crude humor.
